title: The Lord Is There
verse: The following night the Lord stood near Paul and said, “Have courage, for just as you have testified about me in Jerusalem, so you must also testify in Rome.
observation: I can only imagine how intimidating this season might have been for Paul. I have been in seasons when I was trying to honor God, but it did not seem as though there were any clear answers. Is it more honoring to go left or right? Should I honor God with this decision or that decision? If so many people disagree, is that God’s way of telling me I am going the wrong direction? In moments like this, it can be crushing to keep a proper perspective. The Lord came to Paul and reminded him of the ultimate mission. He was to continue sharing the good news in all the different environments this journey led him into. We need to also remember that our ultimate goal is to live for God and share His message. No matter where our good or bad decisions lead, always see them as an opportunity to live for the Lord in front of people. Not as a pride flex, but as a humble example of what God can do.
application: See every situation as an opportunity to shine for God today.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being with us in every situation.
